pricingSummary.en: Free tier with GPT-4o mini · Plus $20/mo unlocks GPT-5, image generation, voice mode.
pricingSummary.zh: 免费版含 GPT-4o mini；Plus 20 美元/月解锁 GPT-5、图像、语音。

faq.a_en: Yes. The free tier ships GPT-4o mini. The $20/month Plus plan adds GPT-5, image generation, and voice mode.
faq.a_zh: 免费版包含 GPT-4o mini。Plus（20 美元/月）解锁 GPT-5、图像生成和语音模式。

faq.a_en: General thinking, drafting, and quick research. It is the strongest all-round assistant we tested for daily productivity.
faq.a_zh: 通用思考、写作草稿和快速研究。是我们实测中最全能的日常助手。

faq.q_en: How does ChatGPT compare with Claude?
faq.q_zh: ChatGPT 和 Claude 有什么区别？
faq.a_en: ChatGPT is more well-rounded with voice, image and plugins; Claude produces more natural long-form writing and handles longer documents.
faq.a_zh: ChatGPT 更全能（语音、图像、插件），Claude 长文写作更自然、长文档能力更强。

faq.a_en: Yes. OpenAI exposes GPT models via the OpenAI API with usage-based pricing.
faq.a_zh: 有。OpenAI 通过按量计费的 OpenAI API 提供 GPT 模型。

pricingSummary.en: Free tier with limits · Pro $20/mo unlocks larger context and Artifacts.
pricingSummary.zh: 免费版有额度限制；Pro 20 美元/月解锁更大上下文和 Artifacts。

faq.q_en: What context length does Claude support?
faq.a_en: Claude Pro supports a 200K-token context window, enough for a 100+ page document in one prompt.
faq.a_zh: Claude Pro 支持 200K token 上下文，可一次处理 100 页以上文档。

faq.q_en: Is Claude better than ChatGPT for writing?
faq.q_zh: Claude 写作比 ChatGPT 更好吗？
faq.a_en: For long-form English writing with a natural voice, Claude is our top pick.
faq.a_zh: 在自然风格的长文英文写作上，Claude 是我们的首选。

faq.q_en: Does Claude connect to the web?
faq.a_en: Native web browsing is limited today; use Perplexity or Gemini when live search is critical.
faq.a_zh: 原生联网较弱；需要实时联网请选 Perplexity 或 Gemini。

faq.a_en: Availability varies by region. Anthropic publishes an up-to-date list of supported countries.
faq.a_zh: 可用地区因国家而异，请以 Anthropic 官方列表为准。

pricingSummary.en: Generous free tier · Gemini Advanced $20/mo unlocks 2M context and Gemini Live.
pricingSummary.zh: 免费额度较慷慨；Gemini Advanced 20 美元/月解锁 2M 上下文和 Gemini Live。

faq.q_en: What can Gemini do that ChatGPT cannot?
faq.a_en: Native video understanding, a 2-million-token context window, and deep Google Search integration.
faq.a_zh: 原生视频理解、200 万 token 上下文和最深的 Google 搜索集成。

faq.a_en: Yes. Gemini Live offers real-time voice conversations with natural intonation.
faq.a_zh: 支持。Gemini Live 提供自然语音对话。

faq.a_en: Base Gemini is free. Gemini Advanced costs $20/month for higher limits and features.
faq.a_zh: 基础版免费；Advanced 20 美元/月解锁更高额度和功能。

pricingSummary.en: Free for verified students · Individual $10/mo · Business $19/mo.
pricingSummary.zh: 学生免费；个人版 10 美元/月，团队版 19 美元/月。

faq.a_en: Free for verified students, open-source maintainers, and teachers. Others start at $10/month.
faq.a_zh: 学生、开源维护者和教师免费；其他用户 10 美元/月起。

faq.q_zh: Copilot 支持多文件编辑吗？
faq.a_en: Copilot Chat handles some multi-file edits; for repo-wide agent work Cursor is more capable.
faq.a_zh: Copilot Chat 支持部分多文件编辑；仓库级 Agent 场景 Cursor 更强。

faq.a_en: 30+ languages including Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java and C#.
faq.a_zh: 30+ 语言，涵盖 Python、JavaScript/TypeScript、Go、Rust、Java、C# 等。

pricingSummary.en: Hobby tier is free · Pro $20/mo unlocks larger models and Agent mode.
pricingSummary.zh: 免费版可用；Pro 20 美元/月解锁大模型与 Agent 模式。

faq.q_en: How is Cursor different from VS Code?
faq.q_zh: Cursor 与 VS Code 有什么不同？
faq.a_en: Cursor is a VS Code fork with GPT-4-level AI, codebase chat, and multi-file agent mode built in.
faq.a_zh: Cursor 是 VS Code 分支，内置 GPT-4 级 AI、代码库对话和多文件 Agent 模式。

faq.a_en: For full-time developers refactoring code daily, it usually pays back within the first week.
faq.a_zh: 对每天重构代码的全职开发者，通常一周内就能回本。

faq.q_en: Can Cursor read my entire codebase?
faq.q_zh: Cursor 可以阅读整个代码库吗？
faq.a_en: Yes. It indexes your project and lets you chat with the full codebase context.
faq.a_zh: 可以。Cursor 会索引项目并允许你基于整仓上下文对话。

pricingSummary.zh: 基础版 10 美元/月；标准 30；Pro 60；Mega 120 美元/月。

faq.q_en: Does Midjourney offer a free tier?
faq.a_en: No. Paid subscriptions start at $10/month.
faq.a_zh: 没有免费额度，10 美元/月起。

faq.a_en: The web app and the Discord bot both work; the web app is the recommended default in 2026.
faq.a_zh: 支持网页版和 Discord；2026 年推荐使用网页版。

faq.a_en: Standard and higher plans grant commercial usage rights.
faq.a_zh: 标准版及以上支持商用。

pricingSummary.en: Open source and free to self-host · Cloud hosts charge per generation.
pricingSummary.zh: 开源可自部署；云服务按次收费。

faq.q_en: Do I need a GPU for Stable Diffusion?
faq.q_zh: Stable Diffusion 需要 GPU 吗？
faq.a_en: Yes for local runs; cloud hosts (RunDiffusion, ThinkDiffusion) work without local hardware.
faq.a_zh: 本地运行需要 GPU；也可用 RunDiffusion、ThinkDiffusion 等云服务。

faq.q_en: How does SD compare with Midjourney?
faq.q_zh: SD 和 Midjourney 有什么区别？
faq.a_en: SD offers more control (LoRA, ControlNet, ComfyUI) but a steeper learning curve; Midjourney is easier for stylish output.
faq.a_zh: SD 可控性更强（LoRA、ControlNet、ComfyUI），学习曲线陡；Midjourney 更适合快速出美感。

faq.a_en: Yes, subject to the Stability AI community license.
faq.a_zh: 允许，须遵守 Stability AI 社区许可证。

pricingSummary.en: Free daily credits · Apprentice $12/mo · Artisan $30/mo · Maestro $60/mo.
pricingSummary.zh: 每日免费额度；Apprentice 12；Artisan 30；Maestro 60 美元/月。

faq.a_en: Game art, character design and concept art; Alchemy mode keeps style consistency across generations.
faq.a_zh: 游戏美术、角色设计和概念图；Alchemy 模式保持风格一致。

faq.a_en: Yes, with daily credits refreshed automatically.
faq.a_zh: 有，每天自动刷新额度。

pricingSummary.en: ChatGPT Plus $20/mo includes limited access · Pro tiers scale to $200/mo.
pricingSummary.zh: 包含在 ChatGPT Plus（20 美元/月）中限量访问；Pro 版最高 200 美元/月。

faq.a_en: Availability depends on region and OpenAI’s rollout; check the official announcement.
faq.a_zh: 可用性受地区和 OpenAI 推出节奏影响，请以官方公告为准。

faq.q_en: What clip length does Sora support?
faq.a_en: Up to 20 seconds per clip with strong character/physics consistency.
faq.a_zh: 最长 20 秒/段，角色与物理一致性表现出色。

pricingSummary.en: Free tier with limited credits · Standard $15/mo · Pro $35/mo · Unlimited $95/mo.
pricingSummary.zh: 免费额度有限；标准 15；Pro 35；Unlimited 95 美元/月。

faq.q_en: Which Runway plan should I pick?
faq.a_en: The $35/month Pro plan is the sweet spot for creators shipping regular content.
faq.a_zh: 常规创作者建议选 35 美元/月的 Pro 版。

faq.a_en: Yes — motion brush, inpainting, storyboard, and Gen-3 upscale ship in the app.
faq.a_zh: 内置运动笔刷、图像补全、故事板和 Gen-3 放大。

faq.q_zh: ElevenLabs 能克隆我的声音吗？
faq.a_en: Yes. Instant voice cloning requires only a short reference sample; professional cloning improves quality.
faq.a_zh: 支持。即时克隆只需少量样本；专业克隆效果更佳。

faq.a_en: 29 languages with natural intonation, including Chinese.
faq.a_zh: 29 种语言（含中文）语音自然。

pricingSummary.zh: 每日免费额度；Pro 10；Premier 30 美元/月。

faq.q_en: Can I use Suno tracks commercially?
faq.q_zh: Suno 生成的音乐可以商用吗？
faq.a_en: Paid plans grant commercial usage rights.
faq.a_zh: 付费版本支持商用。

faq.a_en: Yes. Chinese lyrics generate cleanly in Suno v4.
faq.a_zh: 支持。Suno v4 生成中文歌词效果良好。

faq.q_zh: 什么是转写驱动的剪辑？
faq.a_en: You edit the transcript and Descript trims the audio/video to match.
faq.a_zh: 编辑文字稿即可自动裁剪对应音视频。

faq.q_zh: Descript 能自动去掉口头禅吗？
faq.a_en: Yes. Filler word removal is built in and works on speech in real time.
faq.a_zh: 支持自动去除口头禅，实时生效。

pricingSummary.zh: 作为 Notion 附加组件，10 美元/用户/月。

faq.q_en: Do I need Notion to use Notion AI?
faq.q_zh: 使用 Notion AI 必须先用 Notion 吗？
faq.a_en: Yes. Notion AI is an add-on inside the Notion workspace.
faq.a_zh: 是。Notion AI 是 Notion 工作区中的附加组件。

faq.a_en: For teams already using Notion for docs, yes — it summarizes and drafts inside your existing knowledge base.
faq.a_zh: 已经在用 Notion 写文档的团队值得开通，可直接在知识库内总结和起草。

pricingSummary.en: Free tier · Pro $20/mo unlocks unlimited Pro Search and file upload.
pricingSummary.zh: 免费版；Pro 20 美元/月解锁无限 Pro Search 和文件上传。

faq.q_en: Is Perplexity a search engine or a chatbot?
faq.a_en: Both. It answers like a chatbot but cites live sources for every claim.
faq.a_zh: 两者兼具：像聊天一样答复，同时逐条引用可查证的来源。

faq.q_zh: Perplexity 能取代 Google 吗？
faq.a_en: For research and product comparison it is often faster; for navigational search Google is still preferred.
faq.a_zh: 研究和产品对比更快；导航式搜索仍以 Google 为主。

faq.a_en: Marketing teams that need brand voice consistency across many writers.
faq.a_zh: 需要在多位作者间保持品牌语调的营销团队。

faq.q_en: Is Jasper worth it for individuals?
faq.q_zh: 个人使用 Jasper 值吗？
faq.a_en: For individuals, Claude Pro or ChatGPT Plus deliver similar output at lower cost.
faq.a_zh: 个人使用建议改用 Claude Pro 或 ChatGPT Plus，性价比更高。

faq.q_en: Is Hostinger suitable for high-traffic sites?
faq.a_en: Entry-level plans have shared resource caps; scale up to Cloud or use a CDN when traffic grows.
faq.a_zh: 低价套餐资源受限；高流量请升级 Cloud 或叠加 CDN。

faq.q_en: Does Hostinger include a free domain?
faq.a_en: Yes, annual Business+ plans include a free first-year domain and SSL.
faq.a_zh: 年付 Business 及以上版本赠首年域名和 SSL。
